name: Burst M4
teaser: Small mod to an M4 variant that can single or burst fire
description_html:
Small mod to add a new weapon to Mechanic LL1 that adds an M4 variant that can single fire or burst fire.

Comes with its own realism patch

To install place mod in main spt install directory. And to add the realism patch drag the folder titled SPT-Realism to the user/mods location
